response:
It sounds incredibly exhausting to pour your heart into every aspect of your life—school, family, your faith, and personal growth—only to be met with criticism. When you are giving 100% and actively trying to be a kind, learning person, hearing that it isn't enough can easily lead to feeling worn out and hopeless. Please know that your efforts are deeply valuable, even if the people around you aren't recognizing them right now. 

Sometimes, the expectations others place on us are more about their own unrealistic standards than about our actual worth. It might help to gently shift your focus from trying to satisfy their impossible metrics to recognizing your own achievements. You are allowed to define what "good enough" means for yourself. Consider talking to a school counselor or a trusted mentor who can offer an objective, supportive perspective and help you navigate these heavy external pressures while you practice giving yourself the grace you deserve.
